v3_scope: Records optimizer update attempts, completed and rejected updates, finite-value failures, learning rate and pre-clip gradient norm summaries.

Persists epoch-boundary model, optimizer, scheduler, RNG, loader and progress state; resume replays uncommitted epoch work and validates exact ordered fit membership and deterministic-runtime settings.

Preserves create-only attempt failure evidence, resolves saved running attempts as interrupted during sole-owner recovery when no terminal journal event exists, and reports an orphan in-flight optimizer-step-call count as unknown.
Allows a validated terminal checkpoint to resume for final status publication after all planned epoch outputs have been verified.
limits: All tests and checks are local and synthetic. No campaign data, large arrays, cache generation, real fit, GPU run, remote execution, staging, commit, or publication occurred.

Recovery is bounded to completed-epoch checkpoints; interrupted epoch work is replayed. A missing, truncated, or invalid journal fails closed and is not repaired. This does not establish arbitrary power-loss durability or mid-batch recovery.
JSONL progress events are appended directly and synced every 64 journal events and at recovery boundaries. Event-write and checkpoint-hashing cost has not been measured on campaign data.
No real-data resource profile, GPU numerical check, strict cache-generation run, or scientific quality comparison has been completed. The capability remains unadmitted and is not campaign-ready.
